desc: Ideation: identified product-graph BFS recurrence dist(u,v)=0 if u=v, 1 for single edges, else min over same-label edges u->x and y->v of dist(x,y)+2.

Implement the full solution (bitmask level BFS over vertex pairs): parse input, precompute outmask/inlist/vchars, initialize levels 0 and 1, expand each settled state (x,y) to d+2 via same-label edge pairs, and print the distance matrix with -1 for unreachable pairs.
Run the implementation on both provided samples and confirm outputs match exactly (PASSED both).
Cross-check against an independent brute-force product-graph shortest-path reference on many small random graphs; no mismatches found (verified parity, self-loop, and bitmask-indexing cases).
Confirm complexity bound O(N^3) with N≤100 (per-state expansion is O(indeg(x)) ≤ N, total ~1e6) — performance is safe without extra pruning.
